note: EPA Level III ecoregion -> plant and tree keys (data/plants/species.json; plates in images/index.json). Lists are ordered deadliest / safest / hottest first. Species, identification features, harm, use, burn class and look-alike links were written by worker D2 from the named sources (USDA PLANTS, USDA ARS Poisonous Plant Research Laboratory, USDA Forest Service, CDC/NIOSH, FDA, university Extension). Scientific names and symbols are checked against the USDA PLANTS checklist (plants_name is the PLANTS accepted name where it differs). Distribution is the USDA PLANTS county and state distribution download; ecoregions are EPA Level III, assigned COARSELY: a species is listed for every ecoregion covering at least 10 percent of a county where PLANTS records it, and, for states where PLANTS gives no county, for every ecoregion in that state (state_coarse). Fungi and planted ornamentals use hand-set state lists from the literature. A record means documented there, not common there; no record does not mean absent.
